mapper.select: SELECT id, email_ciphertext, email_index, password_hash, email_verified_at, status, closed_at, failed_login_count, locked_until, created_at, updated_at FROM account WHERE id = #{accountId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT profile_id FROM profile_access WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY profile_id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) FROM profile_access WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND account_id <> #{accountId}
SELECT id FROM report WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report WHERE created_by = #{accountId} OR confirmed_by = #{accountId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocr_job WHERE created_by = #{accountId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit WHERE created_by = #{accountId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_revision WHERE actor_account_id = #{accountId})
mapper.update: UPDATE invitation SET used_by = NULL WHERE used_by = #{accountId}
